2609.18346.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
2609.18346.paper_summary: Large language models (LLM) deployed as autonomous pricing agents may sustain supracompetitive prices through tacit coordination. We develop a causal graph divergence framework that separately measures structural faithfulness and intent faithfulness of LLM pricing agents in Bertrand competition. Across nine LLMs under duopoly and triopoly conditions, collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions: the most collusive model accurately reports cooperative intent yet reasons structurally unfaithfully, while the most structurally faithful model sustains supra-Nash pricing under both market structures. These findings establish that CoT monitoring alone cannot serve as a standalone safeguard against algorithmic collusion.
2609.18346.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）作為自主定價代理的部署，可能通過默契協調維持超競爭價格。<lb/>我們開發了一個因果圖差異框架，分別測量LLM定價代理在貝爾哈德競爭中的結構忠實性和意圖忠實性。<lb/>在九個LLM在雙頭壟斷和三頭壟斷條件下的實驗中，合謀行為和思維鏈（CoT）忠實性在這兩個維度上分離：最具合謀性的模型準確報告了合作意圖，但在結構上卻不忠實，而最具結構忠實性的模型則在這兩種市場結構下維持超納什定價。<lb/>這些發現表明，僅僅依賴CoT監控無法作為對抗算法合謀的獨立保障。
